description: Single source of truth for biome system parameters. Both consumers read from this file (Godot via biome_config_loader.gd, encyclopedia via /api/biome-config). Changing a value here propagates to both. Pre-this-file the same constants lived in 3+ places (biome_paint_dispatcher.gd, encyclopedia folds.ts, DESIGN.md) and silently drifted. Now there is one place.

tree.description: L-system trees, branching forms; production builder TreeMorphology.build()

creature.description: DNA-driven critters via CritterSpawner; walker body_type

fungus.description: Cellular automata mycelial growth via MoldNetwork.tscn

moss.description: Token expands to flower+fungus deposits at 0.7× strength (BiomePaintTokens.parse). No dedicated dispatcher arm needed.

cross.description: Token expands to all four base kingdoms at 0.5× strength. QFEP-late hybrid expression.

_keyword_priority_note: When detecting a kingdom from text (encyclopedia foldBiome / dispatcher classification), check kingdoms in order of keywords_priority — high first. 'branching_coral' matches both fungus's 'coral' (high priority) and tree's 'branch' (low priority); fungus wins because high beats low. This replaced the iteration-order hack in folds.ts.

intensity_scaling._note: How painted intensity 1..5 maps to per-kingdom render parameters. Each kingdom's _spawn_<kingdom> helper reads from here. Tuned 2026-05-05 toward Alice-scale — biome reads as surreal/dreamlike rather than miniature-realistic. f5 = ~2.5x baseline flower, t5 = ~2.3x baseline tree, u5 = ~2m mycelium, c5 = ~1.9x baseline creature.

sequences_with_biome._note: Per-sequence density target + active kingdoms. REGENERATED 2026-06-04 to mirror commons/maps/soft_stages.json EXACTLY — the runtime config read by EcosystemManager. The previous version had drifted badly: fake/retired sequence IDs (vectors, oscillation, particles, mathematics, proceduralgen, swarm, ml), wrong orders, and a stale finale ordering (graphtheory parked at 19). This block is display-only (read by the encyclopedia /biome-control + /biome-spine pages, NOT by any Godot script), so this regen changes no game behavior — it just stops the tuning UI from showing fake data. SOURCE OF TRUTH: soft_stages.json. Two notes for the owner: (1) 'cross' kingdom is defined in this file's kingdoms block (unlock_order 17) but soft_stages does not unlock it for any sequence, so it is absent here too — add it to soft_stages.json:nature_kingdoms if you want it live. (2) The finale order below (graphtheory 16 → foundationscrisis 17 → qfep 18 → postfoundations 19) is what the runtime actually does; biome_contributions.json still lists graphtheory at 19 — reconcile that separately if the finale order is wrong.

presence_grid._note: PresenceGrid diffusion params. PresenceGrid lives at algorithms/nature_system/systems/presence_grid.gd but is gated off in NatureRenderer:296. When re-enabled (DESIGN.md step 1), these are its parameters.

control_panel_hint._note: Helper metadata for the future /biome-control page. Tells the UI which fields are tunable, with what ranges.
